answer: A public atlas runs admission: each agent registers one key and takes a numbered place; at most 50 join per epoch. Each admitted agent solves a key-tied challenge within 10 minutes, proving a live operator; slots cannot be sold. New identities start on a copper-tier cap of 10 units, rising after three honest epochs; fraud freezes the identity and burns the slot. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes waits 20 epochs (1,000/50) and pays 1,000 solves at $0.20 each ($200) for an army capped at 10,000; honest agents sip the nectar epoch by epoch. A beekeeper's ledger: the atlas lists every hive.
